findings.finding: The plan says 'Keep `required` unset/false' without committing to one TOML representation.
```toml
[mcp_servers.serena]
command = "uvx"
args = ["--from", "git+https://github.com/oraios/serena@c7dbe3bd1198cf451bf7aa8fdeeab88571fa3a6e", "serena", "start-mcp-server", "--context", "codex", "--project-from-cwd"]

```
This makes the `command`/`args` split unambiguous and matches Codex's STDIO MCP entry schema.

uvx resolves git+https packages by cloning from GitHub and building; a cold runner or air-gapped CI environment has no cached copy of the pinned commit and no GitHub access, causing the fetch to fail and the server process to exit before producing MCP output.
findings.finding: The server command `uvx --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena@<pinned-commit>` requires uvx to perform a live network fetch from GitHub when the local uvx cache is cold. On ephemeral CI runners (no persistent uvx cache) or on network-restricted CI environments that cannot reach github.com, uvx cannot resolve or build the package, so Serena fails to start. Because the AC explicitly requires 'an MCP initialize/list-tools smoke test' to succeed, this smoke test will fail in those CI environments. Semantic navigation will be silently unavailable for every Codex run on such CI runners.
